remarks: Discover luxury living in this custom-built 5-bedroom, 6-bath Colonial nestled on a private 2 acre oasis with convenient access to the Merritt Parkway. Step into a luminous double-height foyer leading to the inviting living room boasting a striking floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace. Entertain in style in the formal dining room featuring a built-in hutch, or indulge your culinary passions in the chef's kitchen, complete with granite counters, a generous island, and top-of-the-line appliances. Adjacent, the family room beckons with its built-ins and window seats, while the breakfast room, with French doors opening onto a serene blue stone patio, offers a perfect spot for morning coffee. Retreat to the luxurious primary suite, featuring French doors to a spacious deck overlooking the lush grounds, his-and-hers walk-in closets, and a spa-like bath for ultimate relaxation. Outside, stone sitting walls, a built-in BBQ, cooking fireplace, shed, and mature landscaping ensure privacy and outdoor enjoyment. With solar panels generating extremely low energy costs, welcome home to refined comfort and efficiency.
